en.health.blocked.advice: Expand technical details to see the restriction. Resolve it before diagnosing again.
en.health.corrupt.advice: Keep the existing log and check the disk and original files. Messages will not be truncated or deleted automatically.
en.health.corrupt.reason: The session log may be corrupt or incomplete
en.health.failed.advice: Expand technical details to inspect the error. Resolve it before diagnosing again.
en.health.heading: Diagnosis and repair
en.health.healthy.advice: Refresh the session details. No repair is needed.
en.health.healthy.reason: The session can be read normally
en.health.legacy-source.advice: Run a diagnosis to check whether the legacy source can be converted.
en.health.legacy-source.reason: The new DSH version does not support this legacy message source
en.health.missing.advice: Check the original directory and disk. Rebuilding the cache cannot recover missing messages.
en.health.missing.reason: The session log or attachment path does not exist
en.health.notice: Session repaired. Details have been refreshed.
en.health.permission.advice: Check directory permissions, file locks and security software, then retry.
en.health.permission.reason: Permission to read the session files was denied
en.health.published-unreadable.advice: The original log is preserved. Restart DSH and diagnose again. Do not repeatedly repair or delete logs.
en.health.published-unreadable.reason: A new log was generated, but the host could not read it back
en.health.ready-frame.advice: Correct the compression frames, preserving messages and the original log. Ensure no other DSH process has the session open.
en.health.ready-frame.reason: Found compression frame issues from a previous repair; host validation passed
en.health.ready.advice: Rewrite the sources to a host-supported plugin attribution and generate a new log, preserving messages and the original log. Ensure no other DSH process has the session open.
en.health.ready.reason: Found {n} legacy sources; host format validation passed
en.health.repair-frame.advice: Run a diagnosis to correct the compression frames while preserving the original log.
en.health.repair-frame.reason: A previous repair used an unsupported compression format
en.health.repaired.advice: The original log and archive status are preserved. You can preview or open the session again.
en.health.repaired.reason: Repair complete; the host can read the session
en.health.scopeArchived: Checks all archived sessions, regardless of list filters.
en.health.scopeUnarchived: Checks all unarchived sessions, regardless of list filters. Archive and close a session before repairing it.
en.health.unknown.advice: Retry first. If it still fails, expand technical details to check host compatibility.
en.health.unknown.reason: The session cannot currently be read
en.orderBy.label: Order by
